name: claude-plugins
description: Marketplace for tori-vxz's Claude Code plugins: legal-practice skills and unrelated personal skills, sharing one repo and install URL.

plugins.name: calendar-assistant
plugins.description: Reads an uploaded court order, gathers the applicable civil procedure, judge, and local rules, calculates the resulting deadline(s), and calendars them on the correct matter calendar through a provider-agnostic calendar connector.

plugins.name: web-research
plugins.description: Multi-angle web research chain (web-crawler, web-consolidator, web) for one-off research questions or as a research step inside other skills.

plugins.name: trip-itinerary
plugins.description: Builds a full trip itinerary across an ordered list of cities: activities at three effort levels and travel at three budget tiers between every leg, delivered as a spreadsheet or in the conversation.
